theorem checkC2_suffices {Q Q₀ : ℝ} (hQ : 20000 * Q₀ ≤ Q) (hQ₀ : 1e5 ≤ Q₀)
    (hρ : Real.log Q₀ ≤ 0.6 * Real.log Q) {q : ℕ} (hq : 1 ≤ q) {s : ℝ} (hs : 1 ≤ s)
    (hR : 1 ≤ Q₀ / (s * q))
    (hC : Phi2 q ⌊Q₀ / (s * q)⌋₊
      (max (Real.log q) (Real.log (1e5 / ((⌊Q₀ / (s * q)⌋₊ : ℝ) + 1)))) ≤ 0) :
    Gq q (Q₀ / (s * q)) ≤ (Real.log Q₀ + 2) / (Real.log Q + cE) * Gq q (Q / (s * q)) :=

note: Lean proves c₊ = 2 in place of 1.36: [H]'s argument with 1.36 for q ≥ 2.2·10¹⁰, and for q < 2.2·10¹⁰ a kernel-checked Φ ≤ 0 reduction replacing [H]'s computation. Erratum: Step (12.29) uses Lemma 12.2.3 with sigma = 1.36, but the lemma's denominator is log Q + 1.312, not log Q + c_E as (12.23) needs (at Q0 = 10^5, rho = 0.6: 0.627941 against 0.627311). (checked by `scripts/checks/proposition_12_2_4.py`).
